bio: Arnaud is the designated “international film expert” of the Filmball community and regular guest on the Fantasy Filmball YouTube channel. He co-created the Fantasy Filmball game with Matthew and has been a regular player in the official YouTube league since the start of the channel. Arnaud’s specialities include festival reporting, niche awards data analysis, and the specialized categories of award season (animation, documentary, and international).
name: Arnaud Weissenburger
